sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, geometric-centre x/y in the deck-SVG coordinate space, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/msc/msc-meraviglia/vlatest/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one element with class "cabin-shape" and a data-cabin attribute per stateroom (2168 <rect> + 58 <polygon>). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to an MSC Meraviglia stateroom category, using the sister-ship MSC deckmaps palette (MSC World Europa / MSC Fantasia) as the colour reference and cross-checked against MSC Meraviglia's published category totals from cruisedeckplans.com (2,244 staterooms).

notes.completeness: PARTIAL grid. 2218 unique cabin shapes extracted (2226 shapes minus 8 duplicated Yacht Club duplex-suite drawings that span two decks each, de-duped to keep the lower deck). deckmaps serves 13 deck pages for MSC Meraviglia (5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16,18,19); of these, decks 6, 18 and 19 render ZERO stateroom shapes in the source and there is NO deck-7 or deck-17 page at all. Deck 6 is the two-storey Galleria/promenade venue deck (no cabins). Decks 18 and 19 are upper forward MSC Yacht Club decks whose staterooms are NOT tagged as shapes in deckmaps: this is why the file captures only 58 of the 78 published Yacht Club Deluxe Suites (-20). MSC Meraviglia's advertised capacity is 2,244 staterooms; 2218 are mapped here, so ~26 cabins are absent: -20 Yacht Club Deluxe (decks 18/19 not rendered), plus a handful of ordinary staterooms deckmaps did not tag (-4 Interior, -1 Ocean View, -1 Balcony). No whole GUEST-cabin deck between 5 and 16 is missing. Treat this as a near-complete map (~99%) of the standard staterooms but an incomplete map of the Yacht Club.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 19 distinct fills map to 11 category buckets, verified against cruisedeckplans.com MSC Meraviglia counts. EXACT count matches confirm the mapping: Studio/Single-Interior #f9e5f1=32 (pub 32); Family Ocean View #68a4d8=14 (pub 14); Family Balcony #338867=24 (pub 24); Balcony Suite #f49f41+#ef8227=10 (pub 10); MSC Yacht Club Duplex #796c5d=8 unique (pub 8); MSC Yacht Club Interior #d7d5d1=15 (pub 15); MSC Yacht Club Royal Suite #61564a=2 (pub 2). Near-exact: Balcony (#4ca66f 947 + #00443d 162 + #9ac999 168 + #d5e8cf 4 = 1281 vs pub 1282); Interior (#f2a9c5 623 + #fff 10 + fill=none 20 = 653 vs pub 657); Ocean View (#447dbf 67 + #225397 14 + #9ad0f3 40 = 121 vs pub 122). MSC Yacht Club Deluxe #cdc9ba=58 vs pub 78 (the -20 are on the un-rendered decks 18/19). NOTE fill="none" (20 cabins, inboard on decks 5 & 8) resolves to Interior by count-fit here (not Ocean View), and white #fff (deck 9 inboard) is also Interior. Colour palette reference: sister ships MSC World Europa and MSC Fantasia deckmaps legends, re-anchored to Meraviglia by exact count.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. x is the length axis, y the beam. Bow direction detected from cabin numbering (lowest numbers e.g. 10001/10003 sit at maximum x ~745), so forward = high-x third, aft = low-x third of the global cabin x-extent (33.4-750.0); mid = middle third. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic, port/starboard caveat: geometric split of the beam at mid-y (84.6). Cabins above (low y) labelled port, below (high y) starboard. Matches the observed MSC parity (odd cabin numbers cluster top/low-y, even numbers bottom/high-y), consistent with sister MSC ships. This is a viewed-from-above inference and could be uniformly mirrored versus MSC's own port/starboard labelling; validate against a known cabin before relying on side.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; not asserted as guaranteed clear-view).
